entities.name: Generic UE configuration update procedure
entities.description: Procedure for updating UE configuration parameters initiated by the network.

entities.name: Registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE for mobility registration or periodic registration update.

entities.name: De-registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to de-register from the network.

entities.name: Service request procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to request service establishment.

entities.name: CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMPLETE message
entities.description: Message sent by UE to complete configuration update procedure.

entities.name: CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND message
entities.description: Message sent by network to initiate configuration update procedure.

entities.name: DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate de-registration procedure.

entities.name: SERVICE REQUEST message
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate service request procedure.

entities.name: UE request type IE
entities.description: Information element indicating the type of service request.

entities.name: CAG information list IE
entities.description: Information element containing Closed Access Group information.

entities.name: Current TAI not in TAI list
entities.description: Condition where current Tracking Area Identity is not present in TAI list.

entities.name: Current TAI in TAI list
entities.description: Condition where current Tracking Area Identity is present in TAI list.

entities.name: Same access type
entities.description: Condition where access type in DEREGISTRATION REQUEST matches access type of CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND.

entities.name: Request type set to NAS signalling connection release
entities.description: Condition where UE request type IE has value indicating NAS signalling connection release.

entities.name: UE operating in SNPN access operation mode
entities.description: Condition where UE is operating in Standalone Non-Public Network access mode.

entities.name: Ignore CAG information list content
entities.description: UE behavior to ignore the content of CAG information list IE when in SNPN access mode.

relations.description: Aborts generic UE configuration update procedure when current TAI is not in TAI list.
Initiates registration procedure when current TAI is not in TAI list.
Determines whether CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND is ignored based on access type matching.
Ensures de-registration procedure proceeds when access types match.
Determines whether CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND is ignored based on request type.
Ensures service request procedure proceeds when request type is NAS signalling connection release.
Determines handling of CAG information list based on SNPN access mode.
Triggers UE to ignore CAG information list content when in SNPN access mode.
SERVICE REQUEST message may contain UE request type IE.
CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND message may contain CAG information list IE.
